message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red border. Large red uppercase letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. Above this, black text reads "AINUN NAJIB: INI DATAKU MANA DATAMU" and "MENGAPA PRABOWO BERKERAS". Below the title, smaller text says "28 JULI-3 AGUSTUS 2014". A beige banner reads "JOKOWI & PARA RELAWAN" in red and black letters.

The background shows a blue sky with stylized yellow clouds and a white neoclassical building with columns and a gold bird emblem. A large crowd of cartoon-style people is gathered on a green lawn. In the foreground, five individuals are shown from the chest up: a person with black hair and sunglasses, a person with short curly hair in a red shirt, a person with long black hair and large glasses, a person with a brown shirt, and a person in a blue shirt. The blue shirt features a small seated figure in a gray hooded sweatshirt.

The crowd behind them includes people in various attire, such as a white shirt, a purple shirt, and a brown vest. Some hold props like yellow and blue balloons or a red flag with white script. A barcode and "RP 35.000" are printed at the bottom left, and a signature "Hari Prast" is at the bottom right.
